summary.pt: Começou com uma farra com a torcida: partidas privadas com o Esponja, o primo dele e quem estava na live. Depois, um 1v1 ranqueado (vitória por 3 a 1) e 14 partidas de 2v2 ranqueado com o Duolingo, que é Grand Champion, contra Champions 2 e 3: 6 vitórias e 8 derrotas, de Diamante 3 II (1006) a Diamante 3 II (1032), com pico de 1049.
summary.en: It started as a party with the crowd: private matches with Esponja, his cousin and whoever was on the live. Then a ranked 1v1 (a 3-1 win) and 14 ranked 2v2 matches with Duolingo, a Grand Champion, against Champions 2 and 3: 6 wins and 8 losses, from Diamond 3 II (1006) to Diamond 3 II (1032), peaking at 1049.
